query:
UPDATE forum_sub_categories
             SET threads_amount = (
                     SELECT COUNT(*)
                     FROM forum_threads
                     WHERE forum_threads.forum_sub_category_id = forum_sub_categories.id
                 ),
                 posts_amount = (
                     SELECT COUNT(*)
                     FROM forum_posts
                     JOIN forum_threads ON forum_posts.forum_thread_id = forum_threads.id
                     WHERE forum_threads.forum_sub_category_id = forum_sub_categories.id
                 )
